mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id AS scheduleId, exercise_day AS exerciseDay, exercise_time AS exerciseTime, use_alert AS useAlert FROM EXERCISE_SCHEDULE WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY exercise_day ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXERCISE_SCHEDULE (user_id, exercise_day, exercise_time, use_alert) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dto.exerciseDay}, #{dto.exerciseTime}, #{dto.useAlert})
mapper.select: SELECT es.schedule_id AS scheduleId, es.exercise_day AS exerciseDay, es.exercise_time AS exerciseTime, es.use_alert AS useAlert, es.user_id AS userId, u.tel AS tel, u.name AS name, u.guardian_tel AS guardianTel FROM EXERCISE_SCHEDULE es JOIN USER u ON es.user_id = u.user_id WHERE es.use_alert = true AND es.exercise_day = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%a') AND es.exercise_time = TIME_FORMAT(NOW(), '%H:%i:00')
